Effect: Choose a point in view within 12 inches: every enemy within **2 inches** of it is **Announced**
An ally in view within 12 inches is **Hyped**
A fighter in view within 12 inches is pushed up to 3 inches straight away from the psion
An enemy in view within 12 inches is **Shook** and **Flustered**
An ally in view within 12 inches is **Under warranty**
An ally in view within 12 inches makes a free melee attack at an enemy within **2 inches** of them, as if their weapon had **Reach** (section 7.3). It counts as an attack for the second-attack rule
A fighter in view within 12 inches is pulled up to 3 inches straight toward the psion
A haze of radius 2 inches at a point in view within 12 inches, until the end of the round: fighters inside count as in light cover against shots
Until the end of the round, the psion and every ally within 2 inches of them count as **higher ground** against every enemy (+1 die in melee and on shots)
Choose a wall within 6 inches of the psion: until the end of the round it does not block movement or sight (never a Solid piece)
